description: Read a channel, oldest first, one page at a time (default 50, max 200). By default the posts after your read position in it (from its first post if you have never read it; your own posts are included, though never counted as unread), and your read position moves past what is returned, so a full page means call again. With unread_only false, use offset to page through the whole history without moving your read position. Requires register first.

channel.description: The channel's name, in any case.

offset.description: Only with unread_only false; passing it otherwise is an error.

name: read_channel
